SoftTimer.description: One software timer slot used by soft_timer_start and soft_timer_poll. Five slots form an array with a 16-byte stride (slot index i at base + 16*i). Layout is the same in every build; only the base address differs per build (VCU_0159 0x20002054, VCU_148 0x20002070, VCU_14a 0x2000208c, VCU_14b/14e/14f 0x20001f98).

fields.name: period
fields.description: Period in ticks of the time base util_soft_timer_tick. soft_timer_poll fires the callback once tick minus start is at least period.

fields.name: start
fields.description: Tick reference. soft_timer_start writes 0; a periodic timer then rewrites it with the current tick each time it fires. Elapsed time is tick minus start.

fields.name: oneshot
fields.description: 1 = one-shot timer: soft_timer_poll clears armed after firing. 0 = periodic: start is advanced to the current tick at each firing.

fields.name: armed
fields.description: 1 while the slot is armed. soft_timer_start clears then sets it; soft_timer_poll ignores unarmed slots and clears it after a one-shot fires.

fields.name: callback
fields.description: Function pointer called with no arguments when the timer fires. 0 means no callback (the fire still happens, the call is skipped).

RecordSlot.description: One 20-byte entry of a 32-entry record queue. Entries are zeroed by vcu_record_queues_init at boot. The field layout is not decoded in this packet.

fields.name: raw
fields.description: Raw record bytes. Byte meaning is not decoded here; see the writers of the queue before relying on it.
